name: Thermal / dismemberment

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A charred fibrous rupture and tight flame whip, followed by sustained sizzling heat, crackling embers and a rough falling flame tail. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
